title: Getting started with suest
text: Version 0.1.4 supports probability weights linear, binary logit/probit, Poisson, negative-binomial, ordered logit/probit, multinomial logit models. R’s weights= argument identify weight type, interpretation must declared explicitly suest(). Pweights must finite strictly positive. evaluated values must agree observations included pair models. may differ observations unique one model, including completely disjoint samples. separate estimation samples, suest_newdata() includes .suest_weight: binary implementation uses observed information matrix, matching Stata’s suest covariance links.
code: set.seed(376) weighted <- data.frame(x = rnorm(500), z = rnorm(500)) weighted$mediator <- 0.5 * weighted$x - 0.3 * weighted$z + rnorm(500) weighted$pw <- exp(0.2 * weighted$z + 0.1 * rnorm(500)) weighted$y <- 1 + 0.7 * weighted$x - 0.4 * weighted$z +   0.6 * weighted$mediator + rnorm(500)  base_w <- lm(y ~ x + z, weights = pw, data = weighted) adjusted_w <- lm(y ~ x + z + mediator, weights = pw, data = weighted) fit_w <- suest(base_w, adjusted_w, model_names = c("Base", "Adjusted"),                weight_type = "pweight") fit_w #> Seemingly Unrelated Estimation #> Models: Base + Adjusted  #> Model types: Base=lm, Adjusted=lm  #> Model engines: Base=stats::lm, Adjusted=stats::lm  #> Comparison scale: fitted values  #> Weight type: pweight  #> Observations: Base=500, Adjusted=500  #> Overlapping observations: 500  #> Union observations: 500  #> Parameters: 9  effects_w <- avg_comparisons(fit_w, variables = "x", newdata = weighted, wts = "pw") effects_w #>  #>     Group Estimate Std. Error    z Pr(>|z|)     S 2.5 % 97.5 % #>  Base        1.003     0.0537 18.7   <0.001 255.9 0.898  1.108 #>  Adjusted    0.722     0.0480 15.0   <0.001 167.3 0.628  0.816 #>  #> Term: x #> Type: response #> Comparison: +1 hypotheses(effects_w, hypothesis = difference ~ revpairwise) #>  #>           Hypothesis Estimate Std. Error    z Pr(>|z|)    S 2.5 % 97.5 % #>  (Base) - (Adjusted)    0.281     0.0322 8.74   <0.001 58.6 0.218  0.345 nd_w <- suest_newdata(fit_w) avg_comparisons(fit_w, variables = "x", newdata = nd_w, wts = ".suest_weight")
